question: How emphatically is the truth of this attainment affirmed in the world?
premises: There is no doubt in the world.
The statement is affirmed as truth twice.
inference: The attainment is emphatically and repeatedly affirmed as unquestionably true.
uncertainties: The exact referent of this affirmation depends on the preceding verse.
plain_english: In the world there is no doubt; it is truth, truth—there is no doubt.
